scope: Pirate Borg island-map practice: distinguish creation, adaptation and prepared-map play; no rules inventory

source.locator: Setting sail; island generation and map caption, indexed text

observations.observed_fact: Jake reports generating an island with Down Among the Dead, converting it to a hex map in Tiled with 2-Minute Tabletop assets, and adding the port needed for the adventure.
observations.interpretation: Existing creation example rechecked, not another independent creator. Shows selection/editing after random output; save format and friction unknown.
limitations: Direct page open returns404; map image not inspected.
Solo author, not a group GM population sample.
P2 and X20 are the same case.
No disclosed unmet need or willingness to switch tools.

observations.observed_fact: Shadow describes solo replay on the included Eel Island map, keeping prepared sites while moving their locations mentally to obscure adventure spoilers.
observations.interpretation: Adaptation of existing geography and content, not creation of a new island or a saved edited map. A use case for relocation; no demonstrated software pain.
limitations: Solo replay, not a measured group campaign.
Location edits described as mental; persistence unknown.
Book procedures retold by player are not a verified core/supplement rule corpus.
Images not inspected; no basis to import travel values as verified source rules.

observations.observed_fact: Reviewer reports running one three-hour online one-shot of Trapped in the Tropics, with players escaping the first island. The review describes using the supplied hex maps; a later convention run was planned.
observations.interpretation: A played adventure using prepared maps supports play-now applicability, not independent map generation. Planned convention play is separate and not counted as conducted.
limitations: Review copy supplied by Free League; disclose promotional/selection bias.
One-shot duration and session are reported, not unique creator counts.
No custom-map creation described; absence in this report does not prove author never creates maps.
Future convention announcement is not evidence it ran.

operational_requirement.source_rule_ref: obs-PIRATE-SHADOW-relocation-20261109 (practice report, not a game rule)
operational_requirement.normative_kind: non-normative observed practice; product interpretation only
operational_requirement.applicability: Optional preparation of an existing island; no claim that Pirate Borg requires it
operational_requirement.trigger_or_user_action: Move an existing prepared site to a chosen different hex

inputs_and_units.payload: name and description; no new random content

operational_requirement.product_operation: Reuse the common content.relocate concept: change the selected site location while retaining its prepared content. Check existing editing behavior before proposing implementation.
operational_requirement.expected_output: Site A at1/0 with unchanged name/description; original placement at0/0 removed; other sites unchanged.
constraints_and_exceptions: Source uses mental relocation, so this is a product example, not a literal rules mandate.
Water/land restrictions and occupied-target handling are not supplied by the source; unknown and must not be invented.
JSON persistence below is a product acceptance hypothesis, not an observed author workflow.

acceptance_cases.given: Site A at0/0 named Wreck with description D; target1/0 empty and admissible
acceptance_cases.expected: Exactly one A at1/0; no A at0/0; name Wreck and description D retained

acceptance_cases.given: The accepted document after the move above
acceptance_cases.when: Save and reload the same document without regeneration
acceptance_cases.expected: A remains at1/0 with the same identity/name/description; no duplicate A at0/0

operational_requirement.source_vs_product_interpretation: Observed report supplies the preparation goal only. Relocation/persistence examples are generator-language interpretation, neither new source rule nor approved specification.
unresolved_parameters: Whether author wants software persistence or a different tool
operational_requirement.binding_decision: No new game binding: no primary game rule read; no new canonical registry.

sources_vs_conclusions.sources: Two full first-person reports and one indexed recheck; itch landing page separately screened, no PDF read.
conclusions: Jake remains one existing creation example; not new reach.
Shadow supplies a distinct adaptation case; Burn After Running supplies prepared-map play.
Reported Tiled workflow is an existing alternative; unmet need remains unverified.
unknown: Distribution and denominator of independent map makers
Tool switching demand and save formats
Exact edition of core behind each play report
Core/Down Among the Dead rule pages; no rule extraction attempted

deduplication.not_aggregate_people: Three author/project records are not a population estimate or three proven prospective users.

screened_not_counted.finding: An existing island generator and hex-grid download; no PDF read, user count or independent usage proven.
Creation claim discovered but author identity/text not sufficiently verified; excluded from final observation set.

method_experiment: Not required: existing gm_materials collection type; no new metric or numerical weight
product_disposition: Existing HX-BL-013/content.relocate only as a reuse lead; no new task, no scope/status/queue change. No missing function asserted.
